post.description:
This is Serper's only cursor-paginated stable endpoint and does not support mini-batch. The catalog schema cannot express one-of-required, so callers must supply cid, fid, or placeId; omitting all three produces an unbilled upstream error.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.001 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.000001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cid.description: Google customer ID. Supply at least one of cid, fid, or placeId.

fid.description: Google feature ID. Supply at least one of cid, fid, or placeId.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor from the preceding response.

placeId.description: Google place ID. Supply at least one of cid, fid, or placeId.
